subject: [RUN DONE] rl4cv expt20 trainer smoke: FAILED gate
body:
Experiment 20 trainer smoke completed both updates and failed the fixed log-probability consistency gate. Maximum mismatch: 22,654/864,717 = 2.6198%, versus at most 1% allowed (absolute log-probability tolerance 0.05). Update 1 was 2.5989%. This does not establish a null effect for IRT (item response theory) prompt selection; the held-out comparison was not reached.

Sherlock job 48857034 ended 10-21-2026 14:09:11 PDT, exit 3:0, 1,959 allocated GPU-seconds. Including the two earlier infrastructure failures, trainer smoke used 0.5900 GPU-hours of the 15-hour pilot cap; API spend $0. All 256 rollout records are retained. The adopted custom optimizer loop differs from the runbook-required GRPOTrainer and is documented.

No pilot, main training, calibration scoring or validation evaluation will launch. The adopted calibration array is still finishing naturally under the no-cancellation instruction; final experiment accounting will follow.
